card.line: Jegar-sahadutha is the name Laban gave to a mound of stones, meaning "heap of testimony," that marked a promise between him and Jacob.

moments.title: A mound of stones
moments.text: Jacob's relatives gathered stones and made a mound, and they ate there by it. Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha, and Jacob called it Galeed.

moments.title: A witness between them
moments.text: Laban called the mound a witness between him and Jacob. He asked the LORD to keep watch, said neither man would go past it to harm the other, and asked the God of Abraham and the God of Nahor to judge between them. Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.
